content: Dart Stream.listen: onData, onError and onDone are all optional. cancelOnError defaults to false, so an error does NOT end the subscription — an onError-only backstop therefore protects against the case that was never fatal. A done event DOES end the subscription permanently, and with onDone null 'nothing happens': no log, no signal, and the consumer keeps looking healthy while receiving nothing forever. If onError is omitted, errors go to the Zone handler. Testing a completed source under a live consumer needs a fake that can close the source controller WITHOUT disposing the consumer — otherwise the consumer's own dispose cancels first and the done event is never delivered.
